title: Suwon's fortress wall still stretches for nearly 6 km
body: King Jeongjo built strong defences at Suwon near the end of Korea's 18th century. Hwaseong's walls include four gates and towers, and their design combined features from Eastern and Western military engineering.
takeaway: Ideas can travel between building traditions and be combined in a single structure.
source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, Hwaseong Fortress (1997)
visual: a stone fortress wall curving past a tiled gate tower in Suwon
